method.activation_transform: row-wise NNLS onto fixed max-normalised profiles
method.pm_regression: NNLS of observed PM2.5 on activations + intercept

traffic.label: Traffic & urban combustion
traffic.description: Freshly emitted nitric oxide (NO) with some NO2 from vehicle exhaust and other street-level combustion, strongest in calm winter air over big cities.

industry.label: Industry, coal & power
industry.description: Sulphur dioxide rising together with carbon monoxide and nitrogen dioxide, the signature of coal, power plants and industry; in this model it also carries much of a city's other fuel burning.

burning.label: Fires & biomass burning
burning.description: Formaldehyde-rich air from crop, forest and savanna fires and household biomass burning, although formaldehyde also forms from plant and urban emissions in hot or stagnant air.

dust.label: Desert dust
dust.description: Mineral dust blown from deserts and dry land such as the Sahara, Arabia and the Thar, often carried hundreds of kilometres.

secondary.label: Photochemical & secondary
secondary.description: Ozone-rich, chemically aged air in which sunlight turns gases into secondary particles; this regional haze is the baseline of PM2.5 almost everywhere.

marine.label: Sea salt (marine)
marine.description: Sea-salt spray from breaking ocean waves, carried inland by onshore winds at coastal sites.

background.label: Regional background & other
background.description: PM2.5 that none of the tracer factors explains: long-range background and local sources the global CAMS model does not capture.
